outcome: Neonatal assisted ventilation use greater than 6 h
cohort: 28,584 women with three or more prior cesarean births
finding: Higher order cesarean births performed early term were associated with an increased risk of neonatal assisted ventilation use greater than 6 h compared with full-term births.
mod_finding: This study compared neonatal outcomes between early-term and full-term cesarean deliveries in women with three or more prior cesarean births.
gest_age: Early term (37-38 weeks) and full-term (39-39 weeks)
